integrity: Proof and finite checker supplied; finite tests are not a proof of asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite field and fixed positive intensity; first-order vector-space language with an independent unary point predicate only. The Poisson-subsums numerical spectrum was already shown for sparse ordered bit strings by St. John (1997); the asserted distinction here is its nontrivial vector-space EF collapse. Independent validation and historical-priority certification have not been performed.
title: Sparse markings of finite vector spaces are first-order count-complete
